description: Centralize Mara's proper-name person rendering, tier absurd manipulation verbs, and preserve the clean offscreen cutaway gag

replacements.new:
<ROUTINE MARA-PRINT-NAME ()
    <PRINTD ,MARA>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE MARA-TAKE-REFUSAL ()
    <MARA-PRINT-NAME>
    <TELL " looks down at your hands, then back at you. Take what, exactly? she asks. I am standing here under my own power." CR>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE MARA-EAT-REFUSAL ()
    <MARA-PRINT-NAME>
    <TELL " lowers the field notebook very slowly. No, she says. A beat passes. Also, what the hell?" CR>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE MARA-RELOCATION-REFUSAL ()
    <MARA-PRINT-NAME>
    <TELL " is not an object you get to relocate. Ask her to move if you need her somewhere." CR>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE MARA-SACK-REFUSAL ()
    <MARA-PRINT-NAME>
    <TELL " looks at the brown sack, then at you. That holds sandwiches, she says. Try very hard to notice the scale problem." CR>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE MARA-GENERIC-PERSON-REFUSAL ()
    <MARA-PRINT-NAME>
    <TELL " looks back at you. Whatever you meant by that, it needs to be asked of a person rather than applied to an object." CR>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE MARA-SQUEEZE-GAG ()
    <MARA-ENSURE>
    <COND (<ZERO? <MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-OFFSCREEN-GAG>>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-OFFSCREEN-GAG 1>
           <TELL "Mara gives you a look that begins as disbelief and ends somewhere much less readable. Stay here, she says." CR>
           <FSET ,MARA ,INVISIBLE>
           <TELL "Mara disappears from view." CR CR>
           <TELL "There is an indeterminate amount of suspicious offscreen activity." CR CR>
           <FCLEAR ,MARA ,INVISIBLE>
           <TELL "Mara returns flushed, slightly out of breath, and looking entirely too pleased with herself. Anyway, she says. What were we doing?" CR>)
          (T
           <TELL "Mara points one finger at you. We are not turning that into a repeatable field procedure, she says." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE MARA-WITNESS-PLAYER-DEATH ()
    <MARA-ENSURE>
    <COND (<MARA-HERE?>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-MODE ,MARA-MODE-INDEPENDENT>
           <COND (<ZERO? <MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-DEATH-WITNESSED>>
                  <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-DEATH-WITNESSED 1>
                  <TELL "Mara is moving before you finish falling. She checks for breath, finds none, and goes very still. No, she says once, with none of her field distance left." CR>)
                 (T
                  <MARA-INCREASE ,MARA-SLOT-DEATH-WITNESSED 3>
                  <TELL "Mara catches you before the floor does. Recognition hits her a heartbeat later. Again? she says, furious now rather than surprised." CR>)>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE V-MARA-EAT-ACTOR ()
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <MARA-EAT-REFUSAL>)
          (T <TELL "That is a person, not food." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE V-MARA-DROP-ACTOR ()
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <MARA-RELOCATION-REFUSAL>)
          (T <TELL "You are not carrying that person." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE V-MARA-THROW-ACTOR ()
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <MARA-RELOCATION-REFUSAL>)
          (T <TELL "You cannot throw a person as though they were inventory." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE V-MARA-PUT-ACTOR ()
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA>
           <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSI ,SANDWICH-BAG> <MARA-SACK-REFUSAL>)
                 (T <MARA-RELOCATION-REFUSAL>)>)
          (T <TELL "You cannot put a person into an object as though they were inventory." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE MARA-RESTRAINT-REFUSAL ()

replacements.old:
<COND (<EQUAL? <MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-MODE> ,MARA-MODE-WAITING>
                  <TELL " She is waiting here by explicit agreement.">)>
           <CRLF>
replacements.new:
<COND (<MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-DEATH-WITNESSED>
                  <TELL " Since seeing you die, she watches your footing with an attention that is no longer merely professional.">)>
           <COND (<MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-OFFSCREEN-GAG>
                  <TELL " She is trying very hard not to make eye contact with you.">)>
           <COND (<EQUAL? <MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-MODE> ,MARA-MODE-WAITING>
                  <TELL " She is waiting here by explicit agreement.">)>
           <CRLF>

replacements.old:
(<VERB? TAKE MOVE MUNG ATTACK>
           <TELL "Mara steps clear before the action can become force. She is another adventurer, not an obtainable object." CR>
           <RTRUE>)
          (T <RFALSE>)>>
replacements.new:
(<VERB? MARA-EAT-ACTOR>
           <MARA-EAT-REFUSAL>)
          (<VERB? MARA-DROP-ACTOR MARA-THROW-ACTOR>
           <MARA-RELOCATION-REFUSAL>)
          (<VERB? MARA-PUT-ACTOR>
           <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSI ,SANDWICH-BAG> <MARA-SACK-REFUSAL>)
                 (T <MARA-RELOCATION-REFUSAL>)>)
          (<VERB? SQUEEZE>
           <MARA-SQUEEZE-GAG>)
          (<VERB? HELLO>
           <TELL "Mara gives you a small nod. Hello, she says. Still here." CR>
           <RTRUE>)
          (<VERB? TAKE>
           <MARA-TAKE-REFUSAL>)
          (<VERB? PUSH MOVE DROP THROW PUT PUT-ON>
           <MARA-RELOCATION-REFUSAL>)
          (<VERB? MUNG ATTACK>
           <TELL "Mara steps clear before the action can become force. She is another adventurer, not an obtainable object." CR>
           <RTRUE>)
          (<VERB? MARA-INVITE-STAY MARA-SHOW MARA-SURVEY MARA-SHARE-MEAL MARA-UNBAR-THRESHOLD>
           <RFALSE>)
          (<OR <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <EQUAL? ,PRSI ,MARA>>
           <MARA-GENERIC-PERSON-REFUSAL>)
          (T <RFALSE>)>>
